title.narrative: Indonesia - Making Indonesia Climate Action Deliver through Environmental Democracy

description.narrative: This UK PACT project was a one-year initiative to support DPR to play effective roles in environmental and climate legislation, budget, and oversight as well in actively promoting climate initiatives regionally ahead of COP26. Against the backdrop of the Covid-19 pandemic, the programme focused on Parliamentary roles in enhancing Indonesia’s green economic recovery.
